metadata.name: IANA Time Zone Database Reference (tzdb 2026e)
metadata.upstream_license: The tz database is in the public domain.
metadata.description: Every zone in IANA tzdb release 2026e with current and standard UTC offsets, DST offsets and abbreviations, transitions for the next 12 months, POSIX TZ strings, countries, coordinates and backward-compatible aliases, plus a country-to-zone index and the 2026 permanent-time changes.

conventions.offsets: Minutes east of UTC (positive) or west (negative), plus the same value formatted as +HH:MM.
conventions.window: observes_dst, dst_offset and transitions cover reference_time to window_end (12 months). Recompute after window_end or after a new tzdb release.
conventions.std_offset: The lower of the two offsets for a DST zone. This matches the tzdb rearguard format and most libraries. For Europe/Dublin the main tzdb data flags winter GMT as daylight saving time instead.
conventions.current: State at reference_time as tzdb reports it. is_dst is tzdb's flag, except for Europe/Dublin where it follows the std_offset convention above. Zones switching to permanent time on 2026-11-01 still report daylight time until then.
conventions.posix_tz: The POSIX TZ string stored at the end of the compiled TZif file. It describes the rule after the last listed transition, for use on embedded systems.
conventions.zone_tab_zones: From zone.tab: one name per region of a country, with a description, for building a country-then-region picker. Some names are aliases (links); resolve them with the links list.
conventions.country_codes: From zone1970.tab: every ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose clocks have agreed with the zone since 1970. The first code is the principal country.
conventions.countries_without_zone: BV (Bouvet Island) and HM (Heard Island and McDonald Islands) are uninhabited, so tzdb assigns them no zone and their zone lists are empty.
conventions.etc_sign: Etc/GMT zones use POSIX signs: Etc/GMT+5 is 5 hours behind UTC (-05:00).
conventions.temporary_modelling: For British Columbia, Alberta, Northwest Territories and Manitoba, tzdb 2026b-2026e model the switch to permanent time at 2026-11-01 02:00 local time as a change of abbreviation only (offset unchanged), to work around a CLDR limitation.

link_reasons.legacy_name: Old country-style or POSIX-style name, for example US/Eastern or Japan.
link_reasons.renamed_1995: Two-part name replaced by a three-part name in 1995, for example America/Indianapolis.
link_reasons.merged_zone: Location that once had its own Zone; its clocks have matched the target since 1970.
link_reasons.same_clocks_since_1970: Location without its own zone.tab entry whose clocks have matched the target since 1970.
link_reasons.alternate_spelling: Older or alternate spelling of the same place, for example Europe/Kiev and Asia/Calcutta.
